meta_title: Locanda Elisa | Hotel with rooms, apartments and bistro pizzeria in Dimaro Folgarida
meta_desc: Family-run scattered hotel in Dimaro Folgarida, Val di Sole: 15 rooms with breakfast or half board, 6 apartments with kitchen and a bistro pizzeria serving local produce. Request your stay proposal.

faq1_a: At Via Campiglio 59 in Dimaro Folgarida (TN), Val di Sole, a few minutes from Madonna di Campiglio: a strategic spot for lovers of cycling, skiing and trekking.
faq2_q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq2_a: Check-in is from 14:00 to 23:00, check-out by 11:00.
faq3_q: Are meals included in the rooms?
faq3_a: In the rooms you can choose bed and breakfast or half board. The apartments have a kitchen and dining room, and the bistro pizzeria is just steps away.
faq4_a: The apartments are pet-friendly. For the rooms, please ask us to confirm when you send your enquiry.
faq5_a: Yes, there is public parking (it cannot be reserved). Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and apartments.
faq6_a: Restaurant 12-14 and 18-22:30, pizzeria 18-23, closed on Tuesdays. To reserve a table call +39 0463 811408.
